mapper.select: select r.* from sys_hospital_repost r inner join sys_hospital_post p on p.post_id=r.post_id where r.author_account=#{account} order by r.repost_id desc
select * from sys_hospital_repost where user_id=#{userId} and post_id=#{postId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_hospital_repost(user_id,author_account,post_id,created_at,original_author_id,original_author_account,crop,planting_time,description) select #{userId},#{authorAccount},p.post_id,#{createdAt},#{originalAuthorId},#{originalAuthorAccount},#{crop},#{plantingTime},#{description} from sys_hospital_post p where p.post_id=#{postId}
